title: security-eng-sync-notes-2026-03-09
content:
Security Eng Sync — 2026-03-09
Attendees: Aisha, Jonah, Marta, Evan, Priya (partial)
Absentees: None
Goals for this sync: quick vuln triage, secrets scanning status, threat modeling kickoff for Private deploy agent, unblock incident playbook edits.

1) Vulnerability triage (30m)
- New findings: Dependabot flagged protobuf-lib CVE-2026-101 (medium) from hosted-api service. Initial triage (Jonah): exploitability low for our config because we don't enable parsing of untrusted serialized messages, but upgrade recommended.
  - Action: Jonah to open backport PR for stable-2025.11 and coordinate with release-eng for canary. Target: 2026-03-12. Linked: JIRA SEC-4321.
- High-risk: container runtime CVE (runc/OCI) reported upstream — note: Dedicated nodes run patched runtime in prod, but some dev boxes on older images.
  - Action: Marta to run image inventory scan across Dedicated and Private staging, produce remediation plan. Target: 2026-03-11.
- Note: Evan reminded team to include SLSA provenance for any rebuilt images used in Dedicated pools.

2) Secrets scanning and secrets hygiene (15m)
- Pager alert last week: API key leak from an engineer's personal gist (closed quickly). Root cause: use of personal repo for quick repro.
  - Short-term: reminder email + Slack post about never storing secrets in public places; use vault: https://confluence.redwood/security/vault-guides (Priya).
  - Medium-term: enable pre-commit hook enforcement for git-secrets in all org repos; rollout plan: bump CI job to fail on secret-detect (opt-in for two weeks).
  - Action: Priya to coordinate with devexp to add git-secrets hook template and a CI job. Target: 2026-03-20.
- Secrets scanning coverage: current tool (truffleHog fork) misses base64-encoded env files in some old repos. Evan to add additional regex patterns and run a 30d historical scan. Target: 2026-03-16.

3) Threat modeling: Private Deploy Agent (20m)
- Kickoff: we need a threat model for the new Private Deploy agent that runs in customer VPCs. Key goals: understand data flow, authentication/attestation, and fallback behaviors when network partitioning occurs.
- Discussion notes:
  - Attack surface: agent bootstrap, KMS integrations, local cache for model weights, telemetry/metrics export.
  - Sensitive assets: customer model weights, API keys for control plane, KV caches with inference prefixes.
  - Threat vectors: compromised customer node vs. compromised control plane vs. MITM during model pull.
- Decision: use mutual TLS between control plane and agent plus ephemeral certs from customer-managed KMS where available. For on-prem, require HSM-backed key attestations.
  - Action: Aisha and Marta to draft threat model doc in Confluence and include STRIDE mapping + mitigations. Target: 2026-03-18 for first draft.

4) Incident playbook and runbook edits (10m)
- We updated the incident playbook to include 'secrets-exposure' run path. Need final review before rolling to SRE.
  - Action: Jonah to pull changes into Security-Incident-Retention-Playbook and request SRE review. Target: 2026-03-12.
- Additions: quick checklist for Dedicated failover when model-serving pool is degraded (who flips traffic, how to scale burst capacity). Evan to draft traffic-failover checklist. Target: 2026-03-15.

5) Open action items review (5m)
- SEC-4205 (rotate signing keys) — in progress (Priya). New ETA: 2026-03-22.
- SEC-4299 (supply chain attestation) — blocked on build infra changes; follow-up with release-eng. Marta will escalate.
- Add note: schedule tabletop exercise for Private Deploy breaches (2hrs) — targeted week of 2026-04-06.

6) Quick wins / housekeeping (5m)
- Reminder: remove long-lived engineer tokens in test orgs; checklist in Confluence.
- Move any leftover demo datasets containing PII to secure storage and purge old copies (Jonah).

Parking lot / deferred
- Deep dive on SLSA 2->3 migration (defer to next month).
- Long-term: automated remediation for low-severity findings (research tooling).

Decisions summary:
- Upgrade protobuf-lib in hosted-api; backport + canary before full rollout.
- Mutual TLS + ephemeral certs for Private Deploy agent; HSM requirement for on-prem attestations.
- Enable stricter secrets scanning with CI fail-safes after 2-week opt-in.

Action items (owner - task - ETA):
- Jonah - open backport PR for protobuf-lib & coordinate canary - 2026-03-12 (JIRA SEC-4321)
- Marta - image inventory + remediation plan for container runtime CVE - 2026-03-11
- Priya - git-secrets hook template + CI job coordination - 2026-03-20
- Evan - extend secrets scanner regexes + 30d historical scan - 2026-03-16
- Aisha + Marta - draft Private Deploy agent threat model (STRIDE + mitigations) - 2026-03-18
- Jonah - request SRE review for incident playbook edits - 2026-03-12
- Evan - draft Dedicated traffic failover checklist - 2026-03-15
- Priya - rotate signing keys (SEC-4205) - 2026-03-22

Notes / context links:
- See Confluence doc: Security-Incident-Retention-Playbook (WIP).
- Refer to GitHub PR: repo-name/patch-PR-1284 for example of backport process.
- Slack: #sec-eng for async follow-ups; tag @oncall when posting alerts.

Next sync: 2026-03-16 10:00 PT (same agenda cadence).

Quick personal notes to self: follow up with release-eng about build infra gating for supply chain attestations. Also remind growth team to not share customer data in demo materials — add to onboarding checklist.
